tagline: 美能达微型相机，1962 年发布
description: 美能达于1962年推出的微型相机。配备Rokkor 1:2.8/25mm,。快门速度shifter shutter with one speed for every ASA film speed setting: 1/30 sec. (25 ASA) to 1/500 sec. (400 ASA), flash synchronized for the two lowest speeds。使用Minolta 16 mm film cartridges, speeds 25 to 400 ASA。two-zone switch: near and far。

specs.胶片/画幅: Minolta 16 mm film cartridges, speeds 25 to 400 ASA
specs.快门: shifter shutter with one speed for every ASA film speed setting: 1/30 sec. (25 ASA) to 1/500 sec. (400 ASA), flash synchronized for the two lowest speeds
specs.取景器: optical, green indicator for sufficient light
specs.英文简介: The Minolta-16 EE from 1962 was Minolta's first 16mm subminiature camera with built-in light-meter.
